evals.prompt: I need to scrape all product listings from a competitor's e-commerce site and extract the product names, prices, and descriptions into structured JSON. The site uses React so pages are rendered client-side. Walk me through how to do this. Describe the calls and their parameters; do not run them.
evals.expected_output: Should recommend firecrawl_map to discover URLs, then firecrawl_scrape with formats ["json"] and jsonOptions {prompt, schema} for structured extraction (one call per URL), or firecrawl_agent for unknown URLs. Should mention waitFor for JS-rendered pages. Should cover the full pipeline: discover URLs → filter → extract structured data → transform.
expectations: Discovers the product URLs first with firecrawl_map
Extracts with firecrawl_scrape using formats json and jsonOptions that hold a prompt and a schema
Mentions waitFor (or JS rendering) for the client-side rendered pages
Says one scrape call per URL, or firecrawl_agent when the URLs are not known
Covers filtering the URLs and transforming the data into the target model
